newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Ganadero's Corfigan net profit rises.
newsitem.headline: Ganadero's Corfigan net profit rises.

text.p: Corporacion Financiera Ganadera SA (Corfingan), the investment banking arm of Colombia's Banco Ganadero, posted a net profit of 565.7 million pesos in 1996, the Securities Superintendency said.
It said the profit compared to a 306 million peso loss in 1995.
The Superintendecy said Corfigan intended to propose, at a shareholders' meeting set for March 11, that 233 million of the 1996 profit be distributed in the form of dividends.
An additional 25.9 million will be kept for legal reserve requirements and 306.2 million will be used to cover 1995's losses, the Superintendency said.
